save_backup.title: Preserve original files before analysis

point_of_no_return.title: Official progression is permanently closed

point_of_no_return.detail: Do not present archival evidence as a currently playable route.

items.label: Document the Final Android and iOS Build

levels.1: This route preserves a discontinued online mobile release rather than a playable modern installation.
levels.2: Use dated footage, screenshots, receipts, and device records from the final official service build.
levels.3: Record the operating system, application version, account region, installed package identity, device model, and capture date. Do not use a private server or recreation as evidence of official behavior.

levels.1: The official download window ended before the servers closed.
levels.2: Archive the delisting timestamp: 2025-10-21 13:30 UTC.
levels.3: Preserve the official notice and any legitimate account-library receipt showing prior download eligibility; do not claim that a new official installation remains available.

levels.1: The closing build temporarily removed ordinary level gates from two major catalogs.
levels.2: Archive the universal Build Mode and appearance-catalog unlock dated 2026-01-06.
levels.3: Use final-window evidence to distinguish automatically opened construction and character items from rewards that still required stories, events, ownership, or account history.

levels.1: The authoritative online world and its server-side saves no longer load.
levels.2: Archive the shutdown timestamp: 2026-01-20 13:59 UTC.
levels.3: Treat every gameplay instruction elsewhere in this pack as historical. A normal official save cannot now be opened, advanced, restored, or newly completed.

levels.1: Paid lots, packs, and currencies were account entitlements, not ordinary play goals.
levels.2: Track purchased ownership separately from career, hobby, relationship, and event completion.
levels.3: Use receipts or pre-closure inventory evidence for paid entries. Mark missing purchases as ownership-gated or unavailable; never describe spending as a required earned-completion action.

areas.name: Final Archival Completion
areas.location_cue: The evidence index, unavailable-content register, original device captures, account receipts, official notices, hashes, and redundant preservation bundle.
areas.note: Completion now means an honest, evidence-backed archive; it cannot mean new official gameplay.

save_backup.title: Preserve two verified copies
save_backup.why: There is no official service from which lost account data can be restored.
save_backup.detail: Keep originals immutable and test both archives.

items.label: Build the Final Account Evidence Index

levels.1: A closed-service completion claim must be traceable to surviving material.
levels.2: Map every resolved item ID to dated official-build footage, a screenshot, a receipt, or an exported record.
levels.3: Hash every source file, preserve capture metadata, record gaps explicitly, and keep privately identifying account information outside the guide pack.

levels.1: Missing live rewards and purchases should not masquerade as current tasks.
levels.2: Assign verified, incomplete, unavailable, ownership-gated, or unverified status to every archival requirement.
levels.3: Separate earned progress from purchases, expired events, absent evidence, and source gaps. Never convert an unknown state into completion merely because the service cannot be checked.

levels.1: The surviving files are now the only durable record of the account's official state.
levels.2: Archive the evidence index, final app package metadata, device details, receipts, footage, screenshots, and this dated checklist.
levels.3: Store two hashed copies in separate locations, confirm both can be read, document the July 18, 2026 research cutoff, and preserve the untouched originals beside working derivatives.
